ESCAPE THE VALLEY
version TEST

When a narrator model is running, the story is written and voiced by AI, live, as you play, and every telling is new. Without one, the game shows plain text lines instead.

Day 1, morning. Coldspring (plains). 0 of 396 miles, 21 to the next stop.
Party: Ruth 100 (healthy), Josiah 94 (healthy), Elias 87 (healthy), Agnes 80 (healthy). Morale 70.
Wagon 80, animals 90, pace steady.
Supplies: ammo 20, boots 2, cloth 5, firewood 15, food 50, lantern_oil 6, meds 5, parts 4, rope 2, salt 8, tools 1, water 50.
T travel   R rest   H hunt   F repair   P pace <slow|steady|hard>   Q save and quit
Last resorts: X abandon cargo   D desperate repair   N hard ration
> Traveled 5 miles. 16 miles remaining.

== Persistent Rain ==
Rain falls steady as judgment, soaking every seam and hope alike.
  A. Continue despite the wet
  B. Wait under canvas
> Choose one of: A, B.
> [Continue despite the wet] The party damages the wagon, loses heart, covers ground on the trail and loses time.
  distance +4, morale -2, time_days +1, wagon_condition -2

== Whispers from the Depths ==
The current carries fragments of old conversations.
  A. Ford while listening
  B. Cross without pause
  C. Camp until quiet
> [Ford while listening] The party loses heart and loses time.
  morale -4, time_days +1

== Old Preacher ==
He speaks of lights that walk the ridges when no man should.
  A. Hear his warning
  B. Pass in silence
> Choose one of: A, B.
> [Hear his warning] The party uses food, takes heart and loses time.
  food -1, morale +2, time_days +1
